rationale: Pedro is building AI agents and tooling infrastructure at ITA Robio, while Kaushik brings hands-on robotics and ML expertise from Mytra—a natural pairing where Pedro's agent-first vision meets the embedded systems and autonomous systems depth Kaushik has developed. intro_message: Pedro Nagamine de Lima, meet Kaushik Prakash — you're both deep in robotics, and Kaushik's hands-on ML and autonomous systems background could be valuable as Pedro scales AI agent tooling infrastructure.
